user.title: Connect to Crowdergy
user.description: Sign in with your Crowdergy account. Create one in the Crowdergy iOS app first.

data_description.email: Email address of your Crowdergy account.
data_description.password: Password of your Crowdergy account. Exchanged once for a token, not stored in Home Assistant.

location.title: Location
location.description: Used for the anonymous district map in the app. Pre-filled from your HA coordinates — only district text and centroid are stored.

data_description.entity_outdoor_temp_c: Sensor with outdoor temperature in °C. Leave empty to use Open-Meteo weather data for your district.

setup_mode.title: Setup style
setup_mode.description: Choose how to register your devices. Auto-Setup scans your Home Assistant instance and suggests devices — you confirm or edit each one. Manual Setup walks you through every device by hand.

auto_confirm.title: Detected devices ({device_count})

device_type.title: Device #{device_number}
device_type.description: Pick a device type and name. In the next step you'll link the related Home Assistant entities.

data_description.device_name: Display name in the Crowdergy app and in Home Assistant.

device_config_mode.title: {device_name} — Control style
device_config_mode.description: How is the heat-pump / AC integrated in HA? Climate-Entity bundles temperature, control and modes in a single entity (Daikin, Mitsubishi, generic_thermostat). Manual links each sensor and switch individually (SG-Ready, Modbus).

device_entities.title: {device_name} — Sensors & control
device_entities.description: Which HA entities belong to this device? Leave fields empty if not relevant for your device type.

data_description.entity_current_power_kw: Current power in W or kW.
data_description.invert_power_sign: On when sensor uses the opposite sign convention.
data_description.included_in_haushalt: On when your haushalt sensor already includes this consumer (common case: shared main meter). Crowdergy subtracts it so nothing is double-counted.

read_section.name: Sensors
read_section.description: Read-only — Crowdergy never writes to these.

data_description.entity_current_power_kw: Current power in W or kW. Grid/Battery: first direction (import / discharge). Solar/WP/Wallbox: the only direction.
data_description.entity_current_power_kw_2: Grid/Battery only: second power direction (export / charge). Leave blank for a single signed sensor.
data_description.invert_power_sign: On when your sensor uses the opposite sign convention.
data_description.entity_soc_percent: Current state of charge in %. Required for Battery and Wallbox.
data_description.entity_vehicle_status: Sensor that signals a car connected to the wallbox.
data_description.entity_current_temp_c: Current temperature in °C — heat-pump flow or boiler interior.
data_description.entity_energy_total: Lifetime kWh counter (HA state_class: total_increasing). Optional — drives daily/monthly/yearly stats.
data_description.entity_energy_discharged_total: Grid/Battery only: second kWh counter for the reverse direction.

control_section.name: Control
control_section.description: Heating in Climate mode: a climate.* entity. Warmwater in Climate mode: a water_heater.* entity. Manual mode: classic control entity + separate temperature sensor. Wallbox/Battery: charge-mode entity.

data_description.entity_climate: Your heat-pump's climate.* entity — control and modes are derived automatically. NOTE for heating: the entity's current_temperature is treated as the FLOW (Vorlauf) temperature, NOT room temperature. Room temp must be configured separately below.
data_description.entity_control: Writable entity (switch, number, select). Examples: SG-Ready select, boost switch, current-limit number.
data_description.entity_current_temp_c: Heating climate-mode: separate ROOM-temperature sensor (required for Crowdergy AI — without it the thermal model can't track comfort). Warmwater climate-mode: optional override if the water-heater entity reports the wrong tank temp. Manual mode: your flow / room / tank sensor (required).
data_description.entity_vorlauf_temp_c: Optional supply / flow temperature sensor of the heat pump (e.g. 'Actual Temperature HK1' on Stiebel, 'Flow temp' on Vaillant). Refines the COP estimate against the assumed W35 reference — 5-10 % better plan quality on devices with an actively-modulated curve. Leave empty if your heat pump doesn't expose one.
data_description.entity_vorlauf_setpoint_c: Manual mode only: writable entity for the flow-temperature setpoint of your heat pump (typically a number.* / input_number.* with °C range 25-55). Crowdergy AI will modulate the supply temp instead of binary ON/OFF — smoother, no hard cut mid-cycle, fixes Stiebel min-run-time issue. Climate mode: leave empty, the setpoint is sent automatically to the climate entity (set_temperature).
data_description.entity_charge_mode: Wallbox: charge-mode select (Lock/Power/Solar). Battery: mode entity (typically a number for +max / 0 / -max W).
data_description.entity_water_heater: HA's water_heater entity for your DHW heat pump. Like the climate entity — control, modes and current temperature derived automatically.

device_values.title: {device_name} — Write values
device_values.description: Which values should Crowdergy write to the control entity? Switch/Input-Boolean auto-fills; for Select/Climate/Number you pick from your options. Note: for user-created input_select helpers the option must carry the RAW state value, not a localized display label — otherwise Crowdergy won't match on read-back.

data_description.value_on: Examples: SG-Ready "Raised", climate "heat", number "16" (wallbox 16 A), switch "on".
data_description.value_off: Standby/off value. Examples: SG-Ready "Lock", climate "off", number "0", switch "off".
data_description.value_cool_on: Heating with cooling capability only. Climate "cool" or your vendor equivalent. Blank = no cooling.
data_description.entity_control_hold: Auto/Always: rewrite the value every 30 s (rescues hysteresis-laden devices). Once: write only once.

device_charge_mode_values.title: {device_name} — Charge-mode mapping
device_charge_mode_values.description: Which options of "{entity_charge_mode}" map to which Crowdergy modes? Each filled field renders one button on the iOS tile (plus the AI button). Note: for user-created input_select helpers the option must carry the RAW state value, not a localized display label.

data_description.charge_mode_value_power: Option that charges at MAX power (e.g. "Power Mode").
data_description.charge_mode_value_solar: Option that follows PV surplus (e.g. "Solar Pure Mode").
data_description.entity_control_hold: Auto/Always: rewrite every 30 s. Once: write only once.

device_battery_values.title: {device_name} — Battery dispatch
device_battery_values.description: Crowdergy AI sets a signed power setpoint (+ = charge, − = discharge) and a mode flag (Active / Passive). Map them to the HA entities below.

data_description.entity_battery_mode: A select / input_select entity with two options: one for Active (Crowdergy writes setpoint) and one for Passive (HA stops writing, inverter takes over its native PV self-consumption).
data_description.value_battery_mode_active: The option string that means "Active — apply the Crowdergy setpoint".
data_description.value_battery_mode_passive: The option string that means "Passive — let the inverter do its thing". Used on every AI-off transition.
data_description.entity_battery_power_setpoint_w: A number / input_number entity in Watts. Convention: positive value = charge, negative value = discharge. Crowdergy writes signed values from this slider's range — HA / inverter clip to current capability.
data_description.battery_setpoint_invert_sign: Enable if your inverter uses the opposite convention (negative = charge, positive = discharge). Crowdergy then multiplies the setpoint by −1 before writing.
data_description.entity_control_hold: How often Crowdergy re-writes the mode. Auto/Always: every 30 s (recommended — some inverters silently auto-revert). Once: write once and stop.

device_vehicle_status.title: {device_name} — Vehicle status mapping
device_vehicle_status.description: Which raw values from "{entity_vehicle_status}" mean what? Crowdergy normalises everything to plugged / unplugged / error.

data_description.vehicle_status_value_plugged: Values your sensor reports when a car is connected — comma-separated if multiple.

device_shares_hardware.title: {device_name} — Shared compressor
device_shares_hardware.description: Does this hot-water device share a compressor with a heating device you already added? Crowdergy then enforces a joint power limit.

data.shares_hardware_with_device_id: Heating device on the same compressor (optional)

data_description.shares_hardware_with_device_id: Pick the coupled heating device. Leave blank for a standalone DHW heat-pump.

add_more.title: Add another device?
add_more.description: Add more devices or finish setup. You can add devices later via Settings → Crowdergy → Configure.
